method.cpu: Sum of process-tree user and system CPU time during engine startup, computation and result delivery; core-seconds, not wall seconds. Linux /proc/<pid>/stat, no debugger or CPU profiler.
method.ram: Peak sum of browser-process proportional set sizes (PSS). Shared pages are proportionally counted. Includes browser baseline; allocated Wasm capacity is recorded separately. Sampled every 0.25 seconds, so very brief peaks may be missed.
method.jobs: Fresh browser profile and fresh engine per point. No OPFS resume. Serial runs. All Bergman engines use monomial pruning; Native uses automatic pruning, memory64 and four requested workers. Firefox may fall back to one worker because shared file access is unsupported.
method.wall: Cold engine wall time includes engine startup, calculation, export and result transfer; browser startup and HTML rendering are excluded.
method.uncertainty: One cold run per point unless multiple trials are requested. Host load and filesystem/browser caches can affect timings. No claim of cross-machine performance.
method.timeLimit: A 120-second cold-job cap applies to remaining runs. Earlier uncapped degree-6 pilots are retained; the plot censors their recorded CPU/RAM traces at 120 seconds.
method.specialized: fomkyr 0.3 uses memory64, four requested/actual workers, exact monomial pruning, cold checkpoints disabled and optional Hilbert disabled. Firefox uses broker-exclusive OPFS; Chromium direct-unsafe.
method.series: Bergman/SBCL/Singular rows are retained from the earlier same-day serial measurements. The two fomkyr curves are fresh serial measurements after all validation suites finished. This is one run per point; the series were measured at different times.

nativeProvenance.order: Degree left lex; Singular Dp with reversed generator order matches Bergman/Native.
nativeProvenance.ram: Native process-tree PSS sampled every 0.02 s. Includes runtime startup. No browser baseline.
nativeProvenance.cpu: GNU time reports exact aggregate child user+system CPU seconds; /proc sampling retained as a cross-check.
nativeProvenance.budget: SBCL dynamic space is 2048 MiB. Singular runs with a 2 GiB virtual-address limit. Browser memory budgets and these native limits cover different allocations.
nativeProvenance.degreeBound: freeAlgebra(r, degree) at each requested degree
